message.content: This is the "Proofing Studio" screen of LoomGuard, a pre-publication brand governance tool, showing a markdown email draft ("Aurelia Black — Spring Rewards Email", 592 chars) on the left and an audit panel on the right with an "Audit Readiness" score of 0, "5 critical" flags, and a "Checkout Truth Engine" panel (PayPal Orders API v2 · Simulation) listing drip-pricing, no-SKU, and verified offer checks with amounts like 19.00 vs 24.99 USD and 10.00 USD.
